name: The Hot Tub Grotto
zone: Underground Midriff — beneath the space between
body:
WARM WATER IN THE BELLY OF THE EARTH. Steam, moody lighting, built-in bench seating, floating snack trays (Elspeth insisted), and A WATERFALL SELENE DEMANDED AND NOBODY QUESTIONED, because when the eight-hundred-and-sixty-three-year-old kitsune demands a waterfall, you build a waterfall.

The ceiling is low, curved, WOMB-LIKE, and a single skylight shows a disc of sky through the earth — moon or sun or cloud — a reminder that the surface exists even when you are deep enough to forget.

THE STEAM RISES THROUGH VENTS THAT FEED THE GREENHOUSE ABOVE, which means the plants are watered by the same warm mist that carries the sound of girls laughing and sighing and confessing things they would never say dry.

Waterproof lingerie is mandatory. Selene's rule: BIKINIS WITH STOCKINGS COUNT. Viraena's response: GOOD.
